sources.title: GitHub - aviadarn/so101-lerobot: SO-101 pick-and-place with LeRobot ...
sources.snippet: Imitation learning on the SO-101 low-cost arm using LeRobot 0.6 and ACT. Phase 1 (this repo, today) runs the whole pipeline in MuJoCo via so101-nexus with a scripted IK expert as the demonstrator. Phase 2 swaps the demonstrator for a physical leader arm; dataset keys and units are already those of LeRobot's so101_follower, so the training and evaluation code does not change.
